title: F3 Contract (MOU)
subtitle: Contracts for your room's projects. The Partner team makes and signs the MOU in the portal; then your room's program officer and finance officer sign it here.
empty: No contracts, or projects waiting for one, yet.

state.waitingPartner: Waiting for the partner to sign

signedInPortal: The signed copy is in the portal with the Partner team.
notSignedYet: The signed copy hasn't been uploaded yet.
portalReviewNote: The project passed screening and is in the portal for its final review before the contract is made.
preparingNote: The project is approved and the Partner team is preparing the contract in the portal.

errors.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Please log in again.
errors.server_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

sign.heading: Signatures
sign.noteDone: Both officers have signed. The partner can now make the transfer.
sign.notePartnerFirst: The partner signs first in the portal. Then the program officer and the finance officer sign here.
sign.noteYourTurn: It's your turn to sign. The transfer can't be made until both officers have signed.
sign.noteWaitingOther: Waiting for the other officer to sign. The transfer can't be made until both have signed.
sign.noteOnlyOfficers: Only the room's program officer and finance officer can sign, each from their own account.
sign.doneBoth: Your signature is saved. Both officers have now signed.
